title: MEMIT layerwise update basis + Mirror memory codes
hypothesis: For a bank of ten local edits whose three layer-tagged linear update matrices share a rank-two edit axis, a shared layerwise update basis plus two generated coordinates per fact can preserve held-out edit RMSE <=0.05 and locality RMSE <=0.05 while using <=0.75x actual bytes of storing every MEMIT-style layer update. Native CP and per-edit rank-two factor controls test whether this is ordinary tensor/low-rank compression.
physical_object: one frozen 3-layer bank of 12x12 base maps and two shared per-layer update atoms
mirror_coordinate: two editor-generated coefficients per fact, decoded through the shared per-layer basis
logical_multiplicity: ten simultaneous keyed edits across three layer-tagged maps; eight train the editor, two are held out
controls: MEMIT-style full per-fact per-layer update bank from the synthetic teacher
same shared tensor factorization implemented as native CP
independent per-edit full-matrix least-squares fit from support
per-edit rank-two SVD factors from support as a cheap factor control

task.type: key-routed synthetic layer-tagged linear maps, not a transformer or factual MEMIT run
task.keys: first ten coordinate basis vectors in R^12; stored in every payload

development.selection_metric: held-out stacked-layer edit RMSE, locality RMSE, route rate, actual bank bytes, editor bytes, and compute

paid_objects: all per-edit keys and router metadata
all MEMIT updates OR shared per-layer basis and per-edit codes OR per-edit rank-two factors
storage.editor_accounting: The cached inference bank is sufficient to serve existing edit codes. Report the actual code-editor payload separately and include it in combined online-edit-system bytes.

compute.query_proxy: Each query charges three 12x12 layer maps, nearest-key distances over ten 12-D keys, and router comparisons. Shared basis decoding and editor ops are reported separately.

gates.PROMISING: Both development seeds: held-out edit RMSE <=0.05, locality RMSE <=0.05, wrong-route rate <=0.01, Mirror bank bytes <=0.75x MEMIT full bank, <=1.0x per-edit rank-two factor bank, and independent full-fit upper edit RMSE <=0.025/locality <=0.05. An exact native CP alias disallows Mirror-specific attribution.
gates.FAIL: Independent upper passes its validity bounds but a frozen quality/storage gate fails or native CP exactly aliases Mirror.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent upper edit RMSE >0.025 or locality >0.05, route validity >0.01, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: This is layer-tagged linear update tensor storage, not sequential causal-layer transformer inference or factual editing.
All methods share the same router and pay all key/radius state.
Shared update basis is learned from training edits only; two held-out edit codes are generated from support signals only.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless all frozen gates pass; native tensor factorization is mandatory attribution control.
